description_en: Creates a key pair for a simple application server
description_zh: 创建轻量应用服务器密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-instance-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --biz-key-pair-name ceshi --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstanceKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair
parameters.name: key_pair_name

Fingerprint.description_en: The fingerprint of the key pair

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair
